“One cannot settle any Platonic question of any consequence by simply quoting Plato,” (Pangle, 193) writes Leo Strauss. Strauss titles a collection of his essay, Studies in Platonic Political Philosophy ; insofar as Strauss Platonizes, he must be quoted with care.
